test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. T sits second to the right of Q. Exactly four people sit between T and A, towards the right of T. D is an immediate neighbour of A and E. If E is second to the right of A and no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated in the row?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) T sits second to the right of Q. 

2) Exactly four people sit between T and A, towards the right of T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3d3234b3ff14e7459f0ffe0deb740d452ce64c8bbb7efb6ad2b429f4a17df4.png] 

3) E is second to the right of A

4) D is an immediate neighbour of A and E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6a60c9336c12c0331d5cfd699c057335d4ebe0ff25c5305b729e4027797f550.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, 10 people are seated in the row.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
